playstyle: Four Khorne-blessed brawlers with modest Health, single-dice saves and slow Move 3 profiles, apart from the swift, dodging Riptooth. Magore's Cleaving hammer, Zharkus's Brutal blows and Ghartok's Staggering strikes give the pack hard-hitting melee that improves sharply once Inspired. With no warscroll of its own it relies on a generic Chaos one, most naturally rewarding kills with extra dice and inspiration. The warband wins by closing in quickly, trading blows aggressively and snowballing off early takedowns.
